title: Hands around the octothorpe
slide_intent: Use an illustration to connect the idea of working together to a recognizable sign. The clear space between figures can direct the eye as effectively as the figures themselves.
strategic_value: Slack can make its mark the meeting point of a shared gesture, giving the collaboration theme a visual form.
demonstration: Four differently colored hands enter from the edges of a pale field. Their gestures frame the multicolor Slack symbol in the middle.
practical_value: Arrange surrounding gestures to lead into a clear central field when the illustrated subject and mark should be read together.

content_islands.name: Hands and central mark
content_islands.spec: Fill all four corners with cropped forearms and hands angled toward the center. Give each arm its own color field. Preserve a light interval around the colored symbol.
